State Newborn Care Quality Manager (Code QI /01)
MBBS/Any other Medical Graduate with post-graduation in Pediatrics (MD/DNB/DCH)

content_sections.heading: About the Project
content_sections.text: AIIMS Raipur, Chhattisgarh is working with UNICEF Raipur to improve maternal and newborn child health care delivery using a quality improvement intervention package. The assignment provides technical support for database management, supportive supervision and teleround for this QI project. The post is in the Department of Pediatrics, and the duty station is AIIMS Raipur.

content_sections.heading: Where and How to Send
content_sections.text: Applications go by Speed Post to: Dr. Atul Jindal, Room No. 1655, B-Block, Third Floor, New Administration Building, All India Institute of Medical Sciences, Tatibandh, G.E Road, Raipur, Pin: 492099. They must reach on or before 07/12/2026 by 02:00 PM. The notice says it is the candidate's sole responsibility to track the application and that the undersigned is not responsible for any postal delay. Envelope: write "Application for the contractual post of ………… under the project titled IMPROVING MATERNAL AND NEWBORN HEALTH CARE QI Project funded by UNICEF, AIIMS." Form: download the application form from the url given in the notice. The same form (Application Form for the post, 01 month on contract basis under UNICEF QI project) is printed on pages 5 to 7 of the notice. The form must be submitted in the given format, with no change in serial number order or column headings. Annexures may be added as separate sheets if required. The form is to be properly typed and signed. Two recent self-signed passport size colour photographs are to be stapled or pinned on the first page of the form. For queries, contact or write to Dr. Atul Jindal, Professor, Department of Pediatrics, AIIMS, Raipur, C.G. Email: [email protected] .

content_sections.heading: Posts, Eligibility and Pay
content_sections.text: Educational qualification: MBBS/Any other Medical Graduate with post-graduation in Pediatrics (MD/DNB/DCH). Age: Upto 40 years. The notice prints no cut-off date for counting age and lists no age relaxation. Skills required: highly proficient in MS Office and well versed with handling large data sets. Command over statistical software package like SPSS/SATA/CSPro/DevInfo/Epi info. Ability to make oral and written presentations on technical issues, and good writing skills. Reports writing experience is preferred. Good command over English and Hindi language. Nature of employment is contractual. The duration is 01 months, extendable to 01 year and more depending on candidate performance and availability of funds. Candidates should check the official notification for the full eligibility details.

content_sections.heading: AIIMS Raipur State Newborn Care Quality Manager Job Description
content_sections.text: In consultation with the QI newborn and child health project team, the Consultant needs to perform the following duties: Contribute in State newborn AMR consortium as per need and suggested by supervisor. Facilitate data collection, compilation, analysis and review related to the project area. Regular coordination with District teams to promote quality and timely data support. Field level supportive supervision/hand holding to ensure timely and standard data-based operations, as per project need. Do daily teleround of IOSNCU. Help the P.I. in conduct of trainings on Q.I, ETAT/HDU and newborn care and any other work assigned by P.I. Analyze the data, identify the gaps and facilitate implementation of suggestive inputs so as to get optimum quality data outputs. Coordination with different stakeholders for implementation of project interventions. Any other task assigned by supervisor/technical reporting person. The supervisor is the Principal Investigator of the project at AIIMS Raipur. Technical reporting is to the Health Specialist, UNICEF, Raipur, C.G. Local and outstation travel is involved as required or suggested by the supervisor.

content_sections.heading: Enclosures
content_sections.text: Duly filled application form in the prescribed proforma, with two recent self-signed passport size colour photographs on its first page. One set of self-attested copies of all relevant certificates. First page of all scientific publications (only PUBMED indexed) and experience certificates, if any. At the interview: the duly filled form, all original certificates of educational qualifications, copies of research publications and experience certificate if available, along with a photo and a set of self-attested photocopies of all certificates.

content_sections.heading: Selection Process
content_sections.text: The selection committee scrutinises the applications received. Recruitment is made through interview, and a written test is conducted if the eligible candidates are more than 50 per post. Selection is based purely on merit. The list of candidates found eligible will be displayed on the college website. Candidates are advised to check http://www.aiimsraipur.in for the date, time and venue of the interview or written test, as no separate communication will be sent. Recruited candidates will be notified through email.

content_sections.text: The interview venue is Room No. 1655, B-Block, Third Floor, New Administration Building, All India Institute of Medical Sciences, Tatibandh, G.E Road, Raipur, Pin: 492099.
